summary: Bound mission history input reads before body materialization and close foreign person holds when their runtime step ends

replay.detail: Read-time projection only; no replay or recovery work.

schema.detail: Uses the existing subject/kind/accepted-time index; no tables, indexes, triggers, migrations or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, retention or coordinated fleet changes.

compatibility.detail: Wire shapes and authority are unchanged. The optional history_complete field is now false when a step's per-kind input suffix exceeds 128 claims plus one boundary event, including ordinary progress notes. At most 1548 bodies are read per step; sparse lifecycle kinds retain independent boundary context. Missing intervals in incomplete history must be treated as unknown. Terminal runtime person-step states close foreign holds, including parent-run cancellation.

downtime.detail: No startup work; detail reads use bounded input windows.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; binary swap-back retains existing data.
